vsm1.6:39.2: imasmiṃ sarīre dve disā nābhiyā adho heṭṭhimadisā
vsm1.6:39.4: Atha vā ahaṃ imissā disāya ṭhito asubhanimittaṃ imissāti vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:40.2: imasmiṃ nāma okāse hatthā, imasmiṃ pādā, imasmiṃ sīsaṃ, imasmiṃ majjhimakāyo ṭhitoti vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:40.3: Atha vā ahaṃ imasmiṃ okāse ṭhito asubhanimittaṃ imasminti vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:41.2: idaṃ sarīraṃ adho pādatalena upari kesamatthakena tiriyaṃ tacena paricchinnaṃ,
vsm1.6:41.7: Yattakaṃ vā pana ṭhānaṃ gaṇhati, tattakameva idaṃ īdisaṃ uddhumātakanti paricchinditabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:42.1: Purisassa pana itthisarīraṃ itthiyā vā purisasarīraṃ na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.6:42.4: ‘‘Ugghāṭitāpi hi itthī purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’’ti (a. ni. 5.55) majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ.
vsm1.6:42.5: Tasmā sabhāgasarīreyeva evaṃ chabbidhena nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:43.1: Yo pana purimabuddhānaṃ santike āsevitakammaṭṭhāno parihatadhutaṅgo
vsm1.6:43.6: No ce evaṃ upaṭṭhāti, athevaṃ chabbidhena nimittaṃ gaṇhato upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:44.2: tena sandhito vivarato ninnato thalato samantatoti punapi pañcavidhena nimittaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:45.5: eko gīvasandhi, eko kaṭisandhīti evaṃ cuddasamahāsandhivasena sandhito vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:46.2: vivaraṃ nāma hatthantaraṃ pādantaraṃ udarantaraṃ kaṇṇantaranti
vsm1.6:46.4: Akkhīnampi nimmīlitabhāvo vā ummīlitabhāvo vā mukhassa ca pihitabhāvo vā vivaṭabhāvo vā vavatthapetabbo.
vsm1.6:47.2: yaṃ sarīre ninnaṭṭhānaṃ akkhikūpo vā antomukhaṃ vā galavāṭako vā, taṃ vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:47.3: Atha vā ahaṃ ninne ṭhito sarīraṃ unnateti vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:48.1: Thalatoti yaṃ sarīre unnataṭṭhānaṃ jaṇṇukaṃ vā uro vā nalāṭaṃ vā, taṃ vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:48.2: Atha vā ahaṃ thale ṭhito sarīraṃ ninneti vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:49.3: yaṃ ṭhānaṃ vibhūtaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti, tattha ‘‘uddhumātakaṃ uddhumātaka’’nti cittaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:50.1: Idāni ‘‘so taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ karotī’’tiādīsu ayaṃ vinicchayakathā –
vsm1.6:50.2: Tena yoginā tasmiṃ sarīre yathāvuttanimittaggāhavasena suṭṭhu nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:50.4: Evaṃ punappunaṃ karontena sādhukaṃ upadhāretabbañceva vavatthapetabbañca.
vsm1.6:50.5: Sarīrato nātidūre nāccāsanne padese ṭhitena vā nisinnena vā cakkhuṃ ummīletvā oloketvā nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:51.1: Evaṃ punappunaṃ karontassa uggahanimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti.
vsm1.6:51.3: Yadā ummīletvā olokentassa nimmīletvā āvajjentassa ca ekasadisaṃ hutvā āpāthamāgacchati,
vsm1.6:52.1: So taṃ nimittaṃ evaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāretvā suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapetvā
vsm1.6:52.2: sace tattheva bhāvanāpariyosānaṃ pattuṃ na sakkoti,
vsm1.6:52.4: tadeva kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikarontena sūpaṭṭhitaṃ satiṃ katvā
vsm1.6:52.5: antogatehi indriyehi abahigatena mānasena attano senāsanameva gantabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:53.2: yena maggena nikkhantosmi, ayaṃ maggo pācīnadisābhimukho vā gacchati, pacchimauttaradakkhiṇadisābhimukho vā gacchati,
vsm1.6:53.4: Imasmiṃ pana ṭhāne vāmato gacchati, imasmiṃ dakkhiṇato,
vsm1.6:53.5: imasmiṃ cassa ṭhāne pāsāṇo, imasmiṃ vammiko, imasmiṃ rukkho, imasmiṃ gaccho, imasmiṃ latāti
vsm1.6:55.1: Sace pana tassaṃ disāyaṃ sobbho vā papāto vā rukkho vā vati vā kalalaṃ vā hoti,
vsm1.6:55.4: Taṃ disaṃ anapalokentenāpi okāsānurūpe ṭhāne caṅkamitabbañceva nisīditabbañca.
vsm1.6:56.4: samantā nimittupalakkhaṇaṃ katvā nimittaggahaṇatthaṃ cakkhuṃ ummīletvā
vsm1.6:56.5: olokentasseva taṃ matasarīraṃ uṭṭhahitvā ṭhitaṃ viya
vsm1.6:56.6: ajjhottharamānaṃ viya anubandhamānaṃ viya ca hutvā upaṭṭhāti,
vsm1.6:56.10: Pāḷiyaṃ hi vibhattaaṭṭhatiṃsārammaṇesu aññaṃ evarūpaṃ bheravārammaṇaṃ nāma natthi.
vsm1.6:56.11: Imasmiṃ hi kammaṭṭhāne jhānavibbhantako nāma hoti.
vsm1.6:57.4: Sace hi so ‘‘etassa samīpe ṭhito pāsāṇo vā latā vā āgaccheyya, sarīrampi āgaccheyya.
vsm1.6:57.5: Yathā pana so pāsāṇo vā latā vā nāgacchati, evaṃ sarīrampi nāgacchati.
vsm1.6:57.6: Ayaṃ pana tuyhaṃ upaṭṭhānākāro saññajo saññāsambhavo,
vsm1.6:57.9: tāsaṃ vinodetvā hāsaṃ uppādetvā tasmiṃ nimitte cittaṃ sañcarāpetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:58.1: Ekādasavidhena pana nimittaggāhaṃ sampādento kammaṭṭhānaṃ upanibandhati.
vsm1.6:58.2: Tassa hi cakkhūni ummīletvā olokanapaccayā uggahanimittaṃ uppajjati.
vsm1.6:58.5: Appanāyaṃ ṭhatvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhento arahattaṃ sacchikaroti.
vsm1.6:59.2: yā gatamaggassa ca āgatamaggassa ca paccavekkhaṇā vuttā,
vsm1.6:60.1: Sace hi imaṃ bhikkhuṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā āgacchantaṃ antarāmagge
vsm1.6:60.2: keci ajja, bhante, katimīti divasaṃ vā pucchanti,
vsm1.6:60.5: ahaṃ kammaṭṭhānikoti tuṇhībhūtena gantuṃ na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.6:60.7: Sace na jānāti, na jānāmīti vattabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:60.12: Jānantena ekadesena kathetumpi vaṭṭati, paṭisanthāropi kātabbo.
vsm1.6:60.13: Āgantukaṃ pana bhikkhuṃ disvā āgantukapaṭisanthāro kātabbova.
vsm1.6:61.1: Tassa tāni pūrentassāpi taṃ taruṇanimittaṃ nassati,
vsm1.6:61.3: amanussehi vā vāḷamigehi vā adhiṭṭhitattā susānampi gantuṃ na sakkā hoti,
vsm1.6:61.5: Uddhumātakaṃ hi ekameva vā dve vā divase ṭhatvā vinīlakādibhāvaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.6:61.6: Sabbakammaṭṭhānesu etena samaṃ dullabhaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma natthi.
vsm1.6:62.2: tena bhikkhunā rattiṭṭhāne vā divāṭhāne vā nisīditvā …
vsm1.6:62.3: evaṃ yāva pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā nisinnaṭṭhānaṃ, tāva gatāgatamaggo paccavekkhitabbo:
vsm1.6:62.4: ahaṃ iminā nāma dvārena vihārā nikkhamitvā
vsm1.6:62.8: Tassa asukasmiṃ ṭhāne pāsāṇo, asukasmiṃ vammikarukkhagacchalatānamaññataraṃ.
vsm1.6:62.9: Sohaṃ tena maggena gantvā asukasmiṃ nāma ṭhāne asubhaṃ addasaṃ.

vsm1.6:63.1: Tassevaṃ paccavekkhato taṃ nimittaṃ pākaṭaṃ hoti, purato nikkhittaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:64.1: Idāni ānisaṃsadassāvī ratanasaññī hutvā cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapetvā sampiyāyamāno tasmiṃ ārammaṇe cittaṃ upanibandhatīti ettha
vsm1.6:64.4: ‘‘addhā imāya paṭipadāya jarāmaraṇamhā parimuccissāmī’’ti evaṃ ānisaṃsadassāvinā bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:65.1: Yathā pana duggato puriso mahagghaṃ maṇiratanaṃ labhitvā
vsm1.6:65.2: dullabhaṃ vata me laddhanti tasmiṃ ratanasaññī hutvā gāravaṃ janetvā vipulena pemena sampiyāyamāno taṃ rakkheyya,
vsm1.6:65.3: evameva … tasmiṃ ratanasaññinā hutvā cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapetvā sampiyāyamānena taṃ nimittaṃ rakkhitabbaṃ:
vsm1.6:65.4: ‘‘dullabhaṃ me idaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ laddhaṃ duggatassa mahagghamaṇiratanasadisaṃ.
vsm1.6:65.5: Catudhātukammaṭṭhāniko hi attano cattāro mahābhūte pariggaṇhāti,
vsm1.6:65.9: ‘Idaṃ pana ekameva vā dve vā divase tiṭṭhati, tato paraṃ vinīlakādibhāvaṃ pāpuṇātī’ti
vsm1.6:65.13: Punappunaṃ taṃ nimittaṃ āvajjitabbaṃ, manasikātabbaṃ. Takkāhataṃ vitakkāhataṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:66.3: uggahanimittaṃ virūpaṃ bībhacchaṃ bheravadassanaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:66.4: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ pana yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā nipanno thūlaṅgapaccaṅgapuriso viya.
vsm1.6:67.2: bahiddhā kāmānaṃ amanasikārā vikkhambhanavasena kāmacchando pahīyati.
vsm1.6:67.3: Anunayappahāneneva cassa lohitappahānena pubbo viya byāpādopi pahīyati.
vsm1.6:67.6: adhigatavisesassa paccakkhatāya paṭipattidesake satthari paṭipattiyaṃ paṭipattiphale ca vicikicchā pahīyati,
vsm1.6:67.8: Tasmiññeva ca nimitte cetaso abhiniropanalakkhaṇo vitakko,
vsm1.6:68.2: Ito paraṃ yāva paṭhamajjhānassa appanā ceva vasippatti ca, tāva sabbaṃ pathavīkasiṇe vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:69.2: yaṃ taṃ ‘‘uddhumātakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ uggaṇhanto eko adutiyo gacchati upaṭṭhitāya satiyā’’tiādinā nayena gamanaṃ ādiṃ katvā lakkhaṇaṃ vuttaṃ,
vsm1.6:69.3: taṃ sabbaṃ ‘‘vinīlakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ uggaṇhanto, vipubbakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ uggaṇhanto’’ti evaṃ tassa tassa vasena tattha tattha uddhumātakapadamattaṃ parivattetvā vuttanayeneva savinicchayādhippāyaṃ veditabbaṃ.
